verdict.rationale: Bench's own docs say founders can access or download an up-to-date income statement (P&L) and balance sheet at any time, with real-time, monthly, quarterly, or yearly views. Accuracy rests on vendor claims of automated categorization, reconciliation and human bookkeepers. However, no cash-flow statement is documented, and period selection is limited to preset views rather than any arbitrary period. Missing for 10: cash-flow statement, arbitrary custom date ranges, independent or hands-on corroboration of report accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: Real-time reporting. Access or download your updated income statement or balance sheet at all times
Custom time periods: Choose real-time, monthly, quarterly, or yearly views for tailored insights.
Download your reports anytime to share with banks, investors, or anyone else who needs them.
